pageSubtitle: Commitment to advancing justice and community well-being through research, human and economic capital development, technical and performance assistance, and volunteer and charitable service.

items.title: RJIC Fellowship
items.description: Co-founded a US$2,500 per year fellowship to support PhD students engaged in inclusive criminology.

items.title: Out Loud & United
items.description: Co-Founder, an organization promoting economic empowerment for Rwandan queer and LGBTQIAA+ communities, especially those seeking refuge from persecution in other countries.

items.title: Community Violence Prevention Project
items.description: Co-led by Jason Szkola, a collaboration of scholars engaged in research and technical support for communities working to reduce persistent violence.

items.title: Foundation of Freedom
items.description: Research Director, an organization focused on expanding economic freedom and opportunity for Black communities.

items.title: Ineza Iganze
items.description: Chair, an organization based in Rwanda, dedicated to expanding education, economic opportunity, and self-determination for young people in Rwanda.
